notes.title: Mothers and Daughters update V6.2
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/aca5a3472356b12aa76f948500259c66362c611c.png"][/img][/p][p]Version 6.2 is now available on the live branch.[/p][p]This version includes evening events for playable day 6, Wednesday, which close out the day.[/p][p]Version 7 will start with updates to the Ren'Py game engine. Depending on issues encountered and testing required, there could be several beta updates dedicated to this upgrade.[/p][p]I've previously mentioned that the upgrade will enable Steam achievements, but there are other important reasons for updating the game engine:[/p][p]Long-term support and compatibility: Ren'Py 7 uses Python 2, which is no longer supported and may develop issues as operating systems continue to update.[/p][p]Security: Ren'Py 8 fixes a vulnerability in the Ren'Py 7 save system that could allow a malicious save file to execute code.[/p][p]Performance and quality-of-life improvements: Faster script execution, more efficient memory use, and smoother gameplay for larger projects.[/p][p]Improved audio/video handling: Better support for modern codecs and formats, reducing playback issues on newer devices.[/p][p]Rendering upgrades: Support for high-DPI scaling, improved font rendering, and cleaner visual effects on modern GPUs and high-DPI displays.[/p][p]There is one small downside to upgrading: Ren'Py 8 is 64-bit only, which means it won't run on older 32-bit systems. For most players, this won't be an issue, since nearly all modern computers are 64-bit.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Haylee (v0.6.2.4 Beta)
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/a9de160f5306ea6f927bcb97b0e659070ae56488.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is the final beta update for version 6.[/p][p]It contains four scenes, and the Chinese translation is extended for the whole of day 1 (Friday).[/p][p]The first scene is with Karla and Noe. This is a relatively brief scene that delves deeper into the troubles in their relationship. Noe is unhappy that Karla is withholding what he calls 'girlfriend duties.' She is holding out due to the inequality in their relationship.[/p][p]This lays the groundwork for Max to steal her away from Noe by stepping up and giving her what she's missing out in their relationship.[/p][p]The next part of the Karla and Noe scene involves Caprice. After Karla walks away, Noe spots Caprice and takes an interest in her.[/p][p]Caprice's response to Noe is determined by several factors.[/p][p]If 'Netorare' is disabled in the game settings, she'll shoot him down as not her type.[/p][p]Netorare is a term used to describe a scenario where a love interest cheats on the player with another male character. This differs from Netorase, which allows the player to share a love interest with another male character.[/p][p]With Netorare enabled, Caprice's response to Noe will be based on her relationship with Max. If you haven't kept up your affinity with her, she'll be more open to Noe's advances.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/f979a2183326cc35f69f34913a468d4c128557ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Following on will be the scene with Haylee, which will make up the majority of the update. [/p][p]Mom will bring Haylee up to Max's room and then leave the two of you alone. Max will show Haylee some self-defense moves before the scene requirement takes effect, and Haylee will either leave or stay for a longer lesson.[/p][p]For her to stay, Max needs to have a Nice Guy Persona with her, and either a High Affinity, or Medium Affinity and have kissed her in an earlier scene.[/p][p]If the player isn't interested in Haylee, they can opt to not show her further moves, causing her to leave anyway.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/fffc6f34942b128c7d8a63f5f4401ae10384f73e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Following Haylee's scene, there is a possible video call with another character. This call will only take place if specific prerequisites are met.[/p][p]Lastly, there is a scene with Mom. This is where Mom reveals she knows about Max's panty collection. This might not come as a surprise if Catherine paid Max a visit the previous evening, as she told him his Mom knows about the panties.[/p][p]The point of the scene is to plant the seed of extended functionality with the panty collection mechanic. Essentially, Mom tells Max she understands young men have certain urges, and she'll wash and return to his closet any panties that require cleaning.[/p]

notes.title: Mothers and Daughters, the TV Series...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/a7c1955188e4623c3304d4ea88dde862cad917d7.png[/img]

...well, that bit was the April Fools!

However, let's keep the idea of a TV show for a little longer to keep things fun and in the spirit of the game's cheeky fourth-wall breaks. 

Before Kimberley became a starlet—or at least before her schedule got packed with filming—she had more time between takes to sit down for this exclusive interview. At the time, she was gearing up to film a key scene: a yoga class where Max finds himself well and truly outnumbered. Now, with the series further along, it's fun to look back at what she teased. Whether you're seeing it for the first time or revisiting it with fresh eyes, enjoy this throwback to an earlier stage of production!


[b]Reporter[/b]: We're joined today by the lovely Kimberley, one of the stars of the new hit show Mothers and Daughters. Fans have been buzzing about her character and all the drama that's unfolding—so we're here to get the inside scoop. Kimberley, how are you today?

[b]Kim[/b]: I'm great, thanks for having me!

[b]Reporter[/b]: I have to ask—[i][gestures][/i]—you're rocking a lifeguard swimsuit. Should we be expecting some daring rescue scenes?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][laughs][/i] Oh, no! Nothing quite that dramatic. This is for the yoga scene.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Yoga… in a swimsuit? That's an interesting choice.

[b]Kim[/b]: Yeah, my character's running late, so she doesn't have time to change. She just keeps the swimsuit on rather than hold up the class. Honestly, I think she kind of pulls it off. [i][smirks][/i] I mean… there's not much difference between a swimsuit and a leotard. It covers what it needs to cover. Well, mostly. [i][winks][/i]

[b]Reporter[/b]: Fashionably late and stylish? I like it. Although, I'm guessing your version turns a few more heads.

[b]Kim[/b]: Well, isn't that the idea... [i][grins][/i]

[b]Reporter[/b]: So, who else is in the class with you?

[b]Kim[/b]: Let's see… besides Max, there's Maria, who plays Karla and Caprice's mom. Then there's Teri—very much a cougar vibe. Talia's there too. You might remember her from when she interrupted Theodore in the supermarket. And we're introducing Lauren, Alison, and Jennifer in that scene.

[b]Reporter[/b]: That's quite a lineup! But… [i][leans forward, playful][/i] I did notice Elena's name on the call sheet. You didn't mention her. Did we miss something?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][grins][/i] Oh! Right, Elena. I didn't forget her—I promise! She works at the fitness center, so Max meets her when he arrives, but she's not actually in the class.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Ah, so she's more of a behind-the-scenes presence?

[b]Kim[/b]: Sort of. She's not in the yoga class, but… let's just say Max might want to make a good first impression.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Noted! So, Max has some decisions to make when he arrives. What are his options?

[b]Kim[/b]: Yeah, he does. He can either come see me at the pool before the class or wait with the others in the yoga studio.

[b]Reporter[/b]: And does either choice give him an advantage?

[b]Kim[/b]: Well… [i][teasing tone][/i] if he comes to see me, it's good for our relationship stats. But if he waits in the class, he gets to chat with Maria and Teri, and they might let slip some… interesting information about the other women.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Speaking of which… [i][leans in, lowering voice][/i] can you give us the lowdown on the best approaches with the various love interests?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][grins, glancing around][/i] As long as you don't tell anyone…

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][playfully whispers][/i] Of course not. I'm a vault.

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][laughs][/i] Okay, okay… So, my character responds to both the Nice Guy and Bad Boy approaches. And we've already seen one scene where the Bad Boy persona was required.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Oh? Any noticeable difference between the two routes?

[b]Kim[/b]: Definitely. The Bad Boy route is her solo path—and the quickest to some of my naughtier scenes, which, I'll admit, I'm really looking forward to filming. But… she's also the jealous type. Flirt with the wrong woman, and she won't take it lightly.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][grins, leaning in][/i] I like the sound of naughty scenes. Can you give us a little more?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][laughs, eyes narrowing playfully][/i] Let's just say... I'm looking forward to stroking Max's ego.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][pretends to be shocked][/i] His ego?

[b]Kim[/b]: That's all you're getting for now...

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][laughs][/i] You're such a tease.

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][winks][/i] That's the idea.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Alright, alright… where were we? Ah, Patricia—your best friend.

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][nods, regaining composure][/i] Right. So, Tricia's a different story. She'll only respond to the Nice Guy approach. But… that's where my Nice Guy route comes in too. Tricia's a little inexperienced, so I'll actually be the one encouraging her relationship with Max if he goes that route.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Wait… so, you're telling me—if Max plays his cards right—he could end up dating you and your best friend?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][smirks, leaning back][/i] If he plays his cards just right… and who knows where that could lead?

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][raises eyebrow, feigning shock][/i] Now that sounds like a situation worth exploring. [i][leans in conspiratorially, eyes glinting with curiosity][/i] Are we talking… friendly competition? Or something a little more… cooperative?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][grins, eyes twinkling][/i] Hmm… I guess Max will just have to find out.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][chuckles, shaking head][/i] You're making it very hard to choose a route here.

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][laughs softly][/i] That's the fun part.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][shifts in her seat, straightening her skirt, clearing her throat softly][/i] Alright, alright… [i][flashes a quick smile, regaining composure][/i] So… what about the other women?

[b]Kim[/b]: For Karla, Max should stick to the Nice Guy approach. She's a little defensive at first, but if he's patient, she'll come around. Now, Melanie—the girl from the ice cream shop—seems like the typical bad girl. She responds well to Max being a Bad Boy. But… she's got a secret.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][intrigued][/i] A secret?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][nods][/i] Mmhmm. And if Max goes the Nice Guy route, he can actually help her with it—and trust me, that'll get him much further with her.

[b]Reporter[/b]: So, being a Bad Boy works, but helping her as a Nice Guy is the better play?

[b]Kim[/b]: Exactly. If he's looking for something deeper, the Nice Guy path is the way to go.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][leaning back][/i] Alright, how about some of the mothers?

[b]Kim[/b]: Ah, the moms. Victoria's definitely a Nice Guy approach, but… [i][grins][/i] she's got some cheeky Bad Boy options sprinkled in.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][leans in, curious][/i] Care to elaborate?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][smirks][/i] Well… if Max is a Nice Guy, he can get away with a little Bad Boy behavior. Like… say… grabbing her backside when she hugs him.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][raises an eyebrow][/i] Wait… so, the grab earns a Bad Boy point, but Max needs to be a Nice Guy to get away with it?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][laughs][/i] Exactly. A little bit of naughty mixed with nice goes a long way with Victoria.

[b]Reporter[/b]: Anyone else we should be keeping an eye on?

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][leans forward slightly][/i] Oh, definitely. Maria's your classic bored housewife. If Max starts courting one of her daughters, it'll make her realize she's in need of some… attention. But to get anywhere with her, Max has to really go after her Bad Boy side.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][grinning][/i] Sounds like Max has his work cut out for him.

[b]Kim[/b]: [i][laughs, winking][/i] Let's just say… he's got plenty of options.

[b]Reporter[/b]: [i][glances at the clock][/i] Looks like that's all we've got time for. Thanks so much for stopping by, Kim.

[b]Kim[/b]: My pleasure. I'll see you… [i][leans in slightly][/i] in class.


Over on Discord, you can join the discussion and help shape the next interview! Our budding reporter has another sit-down with Kimberley coming up soon, and we want to hear what burning questions the community has for our starlet. Don't miss your chance to get the inside scoop straight from the source!

notes.title: Translations
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/97be6957ba5b600d6fbbd1024522861269577efe.png[/img]

An experimental build for testing French and Simplified Chinese translations has been added to the Beta branch.

These are only partial translations, encompassing the main game interface, the in-game tutorial, and the first four scenes of the game (Mom, Karla, Catherine, and Victoria).

Once you pass these scenes, the game interface will remain in your chosen language, but the character dialogue will revert to English.

The language can be set from the Preferences screen. This is a whole game setting, not a save-specific setting, and it can be changed at any point during a playthrough.

The list of languages is dynamic, allowing it to easily support community-made translations.

How the game dynamically displays text, such as adding the walkthrough hints to the choice menu, breaks how Renpy handles translation substitution.

The choice menu has been rewritten in the new beta build to better accommodate Renpy's translation system. The change has been implemented to preserve backward compatibility, as many players create saves on the choice screens.

Other systems have also been changed, but not every instance of dynamic text has been updated. There will still be screens displaying English or a mix of English and French/Chinese (if you change the language).

The main menu will display a fall-back option to revert to English. This is in case any bugs or other issues prevent a player from accessing the preferences screen.

notes.title: Mothers and Daughters update V6.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/aff7cec6602a9a2a143fa30ef2cd6e86ef74ce19.png[/img]

Version 6.1 is now available on the live branch.

This version includes 6.0 (morning events) and 6.1 (afternoon events) for playable day 6, Wednesday.

This is a quirk with how the college events work, with them either in the morning or afternoon based on player selection. 

Events included are:
Fashion with Mrs Anderson on the Creative course.
Marketing with Mrs White on the Business course.
Structural Engineering with Mr Carter on the Engineering course.
Philosophy with Mrs Anderson on the Humanities course.
Lunch with Dean Stuart or lunch with Keira and Natasha.

In addition, there are changes to the in-game smartphone, with it now accessible almost all the time. It also adds a new Favorite app to the smartphone, allowing you to save almost any image to a gallery. Like the computer app, the smartphone calendar app now displays the week ahead.

The next phase is version 6.2, which will contain evening events. Starting with Melanie and Patricia or Teri, followed by the fight scene in the parking lot, leading to Meghan (Lieutenant Carter) and Mom, with Haylee's event rounding out the evening if you have the relevant Affinity/Person.

As we move into Version 7, I will be looking to update the Ren'Py engine to the latest stable version, which will support Steam Achievements. These must be SFW, so those won't directly mimic the current in-game trophies.

Version 8 will start with the three extra credit activities, Acting, Dance, and Automotive, each bigger than the regular college course events. V8.4 will also be the first version to feature a nighttime event, with the group movie night. The relevant attendees will be dressed up for the private showing.

Version 9 will start with a Karla event in the morning before breaking into afternoon events. Which will include the shopping event with Amy and Haylee for the Marketing course.

Version 10 will include the second yoga class with Kimberley if you attended the first one.

Thank you for all your support; we wouldn't be here without you.

The Structural Engineering class has been added to the beta branch.

notes.title: Marketing, smartphones, and animations.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/ca3e66b0c37cc2270aac845aa013e15ed649c6f7.png[/img]

The marketing lecture, part of the business course, is now available in the beta branch.

[b]Changes to the in-game smartphone[/b]

One question I often see on various platforms is why the smartphone is not always accessible.

I have overhauled the smartphone interface to make it available during almost the whole game. There will still be times when the smartphone is disabled, such as when Kimberley takes the player's phone during the pool event.

Outside of the usual areas where you could access the phone, the bedroom freeroam, the location choice screen, several smartphone features will be read-only. This means the player can check relationship stats, photos, tasks, etc., but not change anything, including the home screen picture.

Other characters can see your choice of the home screen picture, and you can't change it at the last minute before someone sees it.

The Settings app will mostly work the same, with minor differences, including a toggle to always display or hide the mini-phone icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/1a8efbab32d808306e4297fb61f893d11ca72ac4.png[/img]

A new smartphone feature, which conversely only works outside the original areas, is a favorite app, shown with a camera icon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/618cfa649dc1fb863aec1f26fd30f79fe5df2fa6.png[/img]

This allows you to save almost any image in the game to a favorite gallery. Since this is part of the smartphone, certain images can't be captured, and some images aren't compatible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/47b3463091208a182c57b8846a96b3a5b3c1fc46.png[/img]

These favorite images won't be available to use on the smartphone, as there's additional information on the home screen to identify which characters and what type of image it is. Hence, the home screen is still limited to the 'look closer' images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/cf31abcd9a5c5ee90c5aadd437b591b6433aa8c0.png[/img]

The Favorite gallery is a separate option on the main menu, independent of playthrough or save files. You can't add an image more than once, and to remove it, hover in the top right and look for the trash icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/cf31abcd9a5c5ee90c5aadd437b591b6433aa8c0.png[/img]

Animations can be added, although too many could impact the performance of the favorite gallery. Your feedback is important to shaping how this feature evolves.

I have been working on several smaller animations to give a little more life to the characters. I'm not entirely happy with the results and will need to spend more time to bring these to a higher standard. Not wanting to delay the update further, these have been pushed to the side for now.

However, I have included one of these animations for your feedback. It's in the early part of the game when you're first introduced to Catherine. The animation plays after you look closer if you choose that option.

notes.title: Beta Branch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/80ad8eb3b970ec2ffca51368021f8d0629e9121f.jpg[/img]

The beta update is now available for you to test.

The beta version will contain partial event updates and is designed for testing. As a partial update, you may load a save and find no additional content for your chosen path.

Saves from the live branch can be loaded, but it is not advisable to take saves from beta back to live. Opening a live save in beta does not affect the original save file.

A feature players might not be aware of is 'Save File Naming,' which is available in the preferences menu. This allows you to name your save files to better track which routes or love interests you are playing.

There is also a chance of bugs or other issues in the beta update.

As this is a beta version, please be mindful when discussing or posting images from the game. Other players may want to wait for the live release. Please mark your threads with "[beta]" in the discussion forums.

This beta version currently contains the Fashion class from the Creative course.

To switch to a custom branch in the Steam client, right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs will be the "Betas" tab.

notes.title: Development Log #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/53679d621e6708b41c45650b74fc2cdfdc815fca.jpg[/img]

Using Steam Branches, you will be able to get your hands on the latest content sooner than waiting for a live update. 

The beta updates will contain partial event updates and are designed for testing. You can load a save from the live branch in the beta update to see and test the latest content, but taking saves from beta back to live is not advisable. Opening a live save in beta does not affect the original save file.

The live updates will always have content for you to play, regardless of your chosen path. However, the beta may not include content for your chosen path because it contains partial events.

There is also a chance of bugs or other issues in the beta update and content changing when it goes live.

More information on how to enable the beta branch will be released when testing is complete and it's ready for you to download.

[b][i]--Spoilers--[/i][/b]

The morning/afternoon college events are determined based on your course selection.


There is a Fashion class in the morning with Mrs Anderson for the Creative course.

Mrs Anderson wants to dive into fashion by starting with a quick dress design experiment. She splits the class into three groups of two. One person to model, the other to design. Max will have the choice to model or design. There will be an option for her to help Max change if he chooses to be the model.


The Structural Engineering class in the Engineering course is either in the morning or afternoon, depending on course selection.

Mr Carter will demonstrate some basic structural principles with Natasha (his daughter) before involving the entire class in a practical demonstration.


Depending on the course selection, the marketing class will be held in the morning or afternoon for the Business course.

Ms. White will split the class into two groups. Since there is an uneven number of students, Max will get a choice of which group to join.

Each group will choose a product group for their fake Marketing strategy.


On the Humanities course, the Philosophy class with Mrs Anderson will be in the afternoon.

Mrs. Anderson will delve into the philosophy of love, using concepts that intersect with history and literature (since those are the other two subjects in this course).

She will read brief passages from historical literature, with two volunteers to act out the scenes. Max will be one of those volunteers, willingly or otherwise. The other volunteer is Caprice.


There will be two lunch alternatives between the morning and afternoon classes. Keira and Natasha are having lunch in the canteen, which is the default choice. 

If you are to be Dean Stuart's intern, Samantha will collect you and deliver you to the Dean's office, where Ms. Taylor is enjoying a quiet coffee with Margaret.

Margaret is unhappy with your appearance and will give you something to change into. With limited space, you can choose to be shy, or not, when changing.


In the evening, there are two routes available.

If you previously agreed to help Melanie make friends with Patricia, you will automatically choose this path.

Max will suggest to Patricia that a friend needs her fashion advice. You will then collect Melanie and take her to the boutique. Patricia's father will insist that she help Melanie select and try on several outfits. Melanie's brash persona will escape her at the thought of changing in front of Patricia, so she insists you join them.


The other route, which is the default, is with Teri in the Cafe. Things are busy in the Cafe, and Samantha is nowhere to be seen. Max will help Teri deal with the rush hour, regardless of working at the Cafe or not.

The situation will be similar to when Max helped Samantha with the coffee machine by climbing under the counter. However, Teri has a more relaxed attitude than Samantha when having a man between her legs.


Max encounters Haylee running as he leaves the boutique or Cafe. She informs him that she's called the cops because some guys are hassling a girl in the parking lot. The girl being hassled is Keira. Max intervenes but can just keep them away from Keira until the cavalry arrives or fight back. Each option has pros and cons for everyone involved.

Regardless of the outcome, Max will get escorted home by Officer Carter (Meghan). After a conversation between Meghan and your Mom, Max will overhear Noe and Karla arguing next door.

In the evening, Haylee will stop by. Depending on your choice during the fight, she's either impressed or upset with you. If you have high enough affinity, and the correct persona, she wants you to teach her how to handle herself. 

If you haven't kept your affinity high with your Mom, she may interrupt you and kill any mood you might have established.


For those unaware, there is a sexual encounter on Kimberley's bad-boy path after the pool event on Tuesday (v5.2). 

Kimberley's bad-boy path is her solo route. She'll get jealous if she sees you flirting with other women; she even gets upset if your head accidentally lands between Alison's breasts when breaking up the fight between Alison and Patricia in the pool.

Kimberley's nice-guy path is her group (and ultimately harem) route. She will encourage your relationship with Patricia as she feels Patricia is too trusting and inexperienced with men. As a nice guy, Kimberley feels you are a good person and can be trusted not to hurt Patricia.

--Spin

Version 5.2 contains the evening's events, closing out playable day 5 (Tuesday).

The pool event is the largest in the game so far. I wanted to create a bigger scene not only from a development perspective but also to give you, as players, more content. This has impacted development time, and your feedback will help guide the balance between time and content.

In addition to any bug fixes, the scene on Sunday morning at the Thomas house offers an additional Bay Boy point with Maria. This is intended to help players who were struggling to activate Maria's scene on Tuesday. If you already played the Sunday scene and selected the relevant option, the additional point will be applied when you load a saved game.

The pool scene also has different paths depending on your persona and affinity with the characters involved. As the game moves forward, that will become more widely used with other characters.

This update includes two short animations. One is added retrospectively to the Movie Theater scene with Natasha, and the other is in the pool scene.

As always, your feedback will help shape further game development.

notes.title: Development Log #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/87c88fd975f8f5d01a2956f952f6891d19a2db56.png[/img]

I know you're all keen to get your hands on the next update, and I'm working hard to bring this to you as soon as possible.

Max's member will get more screen time as we progress through the story. It may even make an appearance at the pool scene.

If you've played Natasha's movie theater, you'll know that Max doesn't have any hair down there. This was primarily out of necessity, as I wasn't happy with the relevant hair products at the time.

The community has voted to change Max's personal grooming habits. Going forward, Max will have a small amount of hair down here to compliment his youthful looks. Previous images will be reworked to match.

I've also been looking at animations, with a short sequence added to Natasha's movie theater scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/c0e80e52f8f6418f3ffb20067a5393608faca5c3.png[/img]

Kimberley's lifeguard swimsuit will be in the pool scene, but with a slight change from the previous scenes it appeared in.

The help information for the Persona system mentions the following:
"Your available actions/dialogue will be set based on your persona with the main character in the scene (which, in most cases, is the first character you interact with for that event). This can result in interesting interactions if you cross paths with two characters at the same time who view your persona differently."

While Kimberley won't be the first character you interact with, the pool event is centered around her intention to train Alison, making Kimberley the main character for the pool scene. Your interactions with her will influence the overall tone and the options available to you.

notes.title: Development Log
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/6722c50e8976c5031eee3705270a05b2b3b65511.png[/img]

Progress on v5.2 (Tuesday Evening) is moving along as expected. 
I had Daz update on me, which almost caused an issue. I don't like to update software in the middle of making an event, as it can cause unexpected consequences. Luckily, the problem the update caused resolved itself.

If you choose the supermarket scene, you have a choice of how to proceed with Lauren. You can take inspiration from Theadore, Lauren's husband, and go down the male domination route. Or opt for a more gentler approach and show her that not every man is like that.

Each path will have pros and cons regarding character progress and the avenues they open.

Pictured is Jennifer Moore, a wealthy business owner. If you play the supermarket path, you'll bump into her on the way. First impressions count, although you may have unknowingly already made an impression on her with your past actions.

Jennifer's opinion of Max will reflect that of her daughter, assuming your path has involved interactions with her daughter up to this point.

Jennifer's first appearance was in Kimberley's yoga class on Sunday, although there was no direct interaction between her and Max during the class. That's not to say she won't remember you.

The default path, if you don't have the supermarket job, is to help Kimberley evaluate a new lifeguard. Alison has applied for the job of lifeguard, hence why Theadore needs help at the supermarket. You will join Patricia in being the willing victims in need of rescue. 

These scenes complement each other in terms of story. Lauren has taken Alison's place at the supermarket, and although Theadore might be a slavedriver, he calls you in to help her. Or you can join the girls in the pool as Kimberley puts Alison through her paces. The pool would usually be closed, giving you and the girls exclusive access.

Following either path, there is the possibility of a late evening event when Max gets home. There are two versions of the event, which will only activate based on your decisions during the day.

Based on feedback, I will add some additional relationship points for existing scenes involving Maria. This will make it easier to trigger Maria's event in the latest update.

--Spin

notes.title: More to come...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371027/7a7a00282de729b68861e929a35228dd180860e3.png[/img]

There have been questions about music, achievements, game mechanics, love interests, and more content. We've avoided any bugs sneaking through into the build, which is an all-around good launch.

While it doesn't show on the store page, cloud saves are enabled. These are configured for cross-platform compatibility for those who play on multiple systems. 

Look to the Steam Community Hub if you have questions or encounter issues. Keeping threads on-topic will help other players contribute or quickly find the answers they are looking for.

The small blocks in the image above give a quick visual representation of the events that make up the story so far. Parts of the story run through mandatory events, and parts are where the player chooses which path to take. With the various routes available, seeing everything in a single play-through won't be possible.

As a story game, more story content is obviously a priority. Besides the story, there are other aspects of the game to be worked on. Which, as players, do you want to see? Music, steam achievements, in-game story map (similar to the visualization above), re-play mechanic, locked gallery images (to show ones you haven't found yet), etc... 

[b]What's next for the story?[/b]
[i]--Spoilers--[/i]

The next scene is with Maria.
Mrs. Thomas has asked for Max to stop by after college. Depending on if you did the spying scene the night before, she may have caught you watching her through the window.
This scene will have some variation for those not interested in pursuing Maria as a love interest.

Following that, there are two paths to choose from. If you've accepted the Supermarket job, Mr. Adams will send you a message asking for your help. This scene will also involve Lauren. There will be a short scene on the way to the Supermarket involving Jennifer.

If you decline or didn't accept the job, you will assist Kimberley in evaluating a new lifeguard. This scene will involve Kimberley, Patricia, and Alison.

Both paths then converge, and there will be an extra scene in the evening, depending on if you took a specific action earlier in the day.

Maria's event will be released separately, with the remaining evening's events coming out in a subsequent update.
